blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Wednesday expressed his condolences to His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, vice president and prime minister of the UAE and ruler of Dubai, over the death of his brother, His Highness Sheikh Ahmed bin Rashid Al Maktoum. In a social media post, Marcos said the Filipino people, the government and his family joined the people of Dubai and the Al Maktoum family in mourning.
